svg.title: GRZ_Research · research focus
svg.desc: Three animated panels: a constant-product AMM curve (DeFi), a simulated Hawkes order-flow intensity (market microstructure) and Monte Carlo paths of an up-and-out barrier option (exotic derivatives).
